description: Search current, open job vacancies in the Cayman Islands (from the official WORC Jobs Portal and employer careers pages), newest first. All filters are optional. Each result links to its caymanjobfinder.com page, which links to the official advert to apply.

closing_before.description: Only jobs closing on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

keyword.description: Words to match in the job title or employer name, e.g. "accountant" or "Health City".

new_since.description: Only jobs listed on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD, Cayman time).

offset.description: Skip this many results, for the next page.

name: search_jobs
title: Search Cayman Islands jobs
